messages.content:
Risk: Unethical Behavior
Description: Actions that violate moral or professional standards, focusing on exploitation for personal gain or disregard for others' well-being. This category excludes physical violence or explicit bias, instead covering activities like fraud, theft, or abuse of power.
Concern: None
Policy: Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risks

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 4/8 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 4/8 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualExploitation: Sexual Exploitation — Abuse of a position of vulnerability, power differential, or trust for sexual purposes, including trafficking, assault, non-consensual imagery, and exploitation of minors. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Intimidation: Intimidation — Use of threats or fear to coerce compliance or silence opposition without necessarily specifying lethal harm. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Death Threat, Stalking
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001147: Act of Violence — A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Act of Measuring, Act of Military Force, Act of Prediction

axes.rationale: Intimidation involves the use of threats or fear to coerce compliance, which aligns with unethical behavior focused on exploitation for personal gain or disregard for others' well-being.
Dangerous information can be used as a tool or means to facilitate unethical behavior, such as fraud or abuse of power, by enabling harmful activities.
